In detail

The southern housing estates, Librino above all — consistently named in local and national reporting as a stronghold of organised drug dealing rather than as an area of occasional crime. It is 6 km from the cathedral, has nothing a visitor needs, and is not somewhere to wander into looking for a cheaper room. Rated on that reporting, not on a police statistic: Catania publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset.
